Company zones (or corporate zones/territories) divide a business's operational, sales, or franchise regions to manage workloads, assign geographic accountability, and streamline local market logistics. [](https://franchise.littlecaesars.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/US-Development-Zones-Map-May-2024.pdf)

- **Territory Management:** Assigns specific sales, leasing, or support teams to designated geographic areas to prevent overlapping efforts.

- **Logistics & Distribution:** Optimizes shipping routes, supply chain delivery, and field service response times.

- **Local Targeting:** Tailors marketing, pricing, and business development strategies to regional consumer demands or franchise guidelines. [](https://franchise.littlecaesars.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/US-Development-Zones-Map-May-2024.pdf)
